title: Make your posts more interesting
description: 20 reusable ChatGPT image-style shortcuts for turning ordinary ideas into scroll-stopping posts.
body:
Your next post does not need a bigger idea. It needs a stronger visual direction. This free six-page pack gives you 20 memorable style codes and the full prompts that make each one work.

## What is inside

Use /cinematic, /editorial, /product, /stopmotion, /polaroid, /bluehour, /goldenhour, /macro, /isometric, /flatlay, /retroprint, /neon, /minimal, /surreal, /luxury, /comic, /paperart, /tinyworld, /explodedview, and /beforeafter.

## How to use the codes

These are creator-made prompt shortcuts, not built-in ChatGPT commands. Pick a code, replace the bracketed details in its expanded prompt, and paste the full prompt into ChatGPT. The guide also includes a simple formula for building your own styles.

## Get a better image

Start with a clear subject, purpose, and style. Add the framing, lighting, and constraints that matter. Once the core idea looks right, make one targeted revision at a time and say what should stay exactly the same.

## Make it yours

Use the examples as a starting point, then swap in your business, products, customers, colors, and story. A repeatable visual language makes your content recognizable before anyone reads the caption.

title: 20 prompts to make your Meta avatar stand out
description: Copy-and-customize prompts for turning your Meta avatar into creator portraits, action figures, posters, sports cards, and more.
body:
Your avatar does not have to look like everyone else's. This free one-page prompt pack gives you 20 distinct creative directions you can paste into Muse and personalize in seconds.

## What is inside

You will get prompts for a signature creator look, boxed action figure, movie poster, creator desk, travel edition, sports concepts, an original superhero, video-game card, tiny diorama, news anchor, red carpet, brand mode, mascot sidekick, future self, seasonal drops, and more.

## Make every version yours

Swap anything inside [brackets] with your own colors, interests, location, goals, outfits, or brand details. Keep two or three signature elements consistent so people recognize your avatar across every variation.

## Get better results

Add your preferred lens, lighting, expression, texture, background, and color palette after the base prompt. Those small creative constraints are what make the result feel original instead of generic.

title: Find your best automation opportunity
description: A quick audit to uncover the repetitive task that is costing your business the most time.
body:
Most businesses do not need more software. They need one annoying, repetitive process to stop eating the team's week.

## The 15-minute audit

Write down every task you repeat weekly. For each task, score it from 1–5 on frequency, frustration, and business impact. Multiply the three numbers. Your highest score is usually the best place to begin.

## What makes a strong first automation?

Look for a process with a clear trigger, predictable steps, and a measurable finish line. Lead follow-up, intake, reporting, scheduling, and routine customer updates are often strong candidates.

## Keep the first version small

Automate one outcome, run it for two weeks, then improve it using real feedback. A useful system today beats a perfect system next quarter.

title: The four-part prompt that gets useful work
description: A reusable framework for giving AI enough context to produce something you can actually use.
body:
A good prompt does not need to be long. It needs to remove ambiguity.

## Use four parts

1. **Role:** Who should the AI act like?
2. **Context:** What does it need to know about your business and audience?
3. **Task:** What exact outcome do you want?
4. **Constraints:** What should the answer include, avoid, or sound like?

## The template

Act as [role]. Here is the relevant context: [context]. Create [specific deliverable]. The result must [constraints and quality bar].

Save this structure and fill it in instead of starting every prompt from scratch.
